overview.description: The Pacer Metaurus Enhanced Core Income Autocallable ETF (ACBE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. ThePacer Metaurus Enhanced Core Income Autocallable ETF(the Fund) seeks to generate monthly income and provide reduced downside risk through exposure to the Metaurus Enhanced Core Income Autocallable Total Return Index(the Autocallable Index). ACBE was launched on Sep 10, 2026 and is issued by Pacer.
